name: bulk-pagespeed-checker
title: Bulk Core Web Vitals & PageSpeed Checker
description: Core Web Vitals for every page in your sitemap, as CSV. Paste a list of URLs (Sitemap URL Extractor can list them) and get PageSpeed Insights category scores, lab metrics and real-user field data for mobile and desktop, one row per URL and strategy. Uses only the official PageSpeed Insights API v5.
seoTitle: Bulk Core Web Vitals Checker (PageSpeed Insights)
seoDescription: Core Web Vitals and PageSpeed scores for a list of pages, such as every page in your sitemap, mobile and desktop, as CSV. Uses the official PageSpeed API.
